title: Analytics Dashboard Discrepancy & Video Views
content: If analytics dashboard shows discrepancies (e.g. email clicks don't match video views): 1) Ensure Infosys tracking JS is not blocked by viewer adblockers. 2) Views under 3 seconds are filtered out by default to prevent bot counting. 3) Real-time sync can have up to 15 minutes lag. For verified bot traffic, we filter impressions. Detailed CSV reports are updated hourly and can be downloaded from Campaign > Analytics > Export Logs. Custom tracking tags (UTM parameters) must be appended to landing page URLs.
